name: STTork public-name review

conditions: Use STTork as the independent project word mark, pronounced stork.
Do not claim an exclusive registered trademark or confuse the project with the unrelated industrial STTORK controller.
Complete qualified clearance before a promoted release, trademark registration, store listing, or logo launch.
Use Zork and Dork only for accurate compatibility, provenance, and historical identification with explicit non-endorsement.

notes: A preliminary exact-name sweep found no GitHub, npm, or PyPI software project named STTork.
An unrelated industrial motor-controller product uses STTORK; this review does not determine legal registrability or exclusive rights.
ADR-0028 records the naming decision and the preserved legacy compatibility identifiers.
